architectureRule: ANAS OS is the single operating system. The domains below are native capability subsystems. Cross-cutting control belongs to the Kernel, Workflows, Contracts, or Foundation rather than creating additional OS layers.

domains.name: business
domains.purpose: Opportunity, problem, customer economics, validation, value capture, pricing and business viability.

domains.name: product
domains.purpose: Problem-to-product definition, requirements, scope, acceptance criteria and product lifecycle.

domains.name: agent-system
domains.purpose: Native AI workforce: registry, roles, contracts, skills, harnesses, context, memory, planning, orchestration, permissions, handoffs, parallel execution, verification, recovery, evaluation, observability, cost and human escalation.

domains.name: engineering
domains.purpose: Software engineering, architecture implementation, testing discipline, maintainability and technical quality.

domains.name: ai
domains.purpose: AI models, prompts, tool use, evaluations, routing, safety and AI economics.

domains.name: data
domains.purpose: Data meaning, models, quality, access, lifecycle, retention, analytics and governance.

domains.name: research
domains.purpose: Customer, market, competitive, technical, vendor, regulatory and evidence research.

domains.name: customer
domains.purpose: Customer identity, needs, journey, feedback, onboarding, health, retention and support signals.

domains.name: integration
domains.purpose: APIs, webhooks, provider dependencies, retries, idempotency, data exchange and migration/degradation strategy.

domains.name: operations
domains.purpose: Production operations, service ownership, runbooks, incidents, maintenance and reliability.

domains.name: security
domains.purpose: Threat modeling, authorization, secrets, tenant isolation, abuse resistance, audit and security assurance.

domains.name: growth
domains.purpose: Acquisition, activation, retention, experimentation, funnel performance and sustainable growth.

domains.name: finance
domains.purpose: Unit economics, budgets, costs, pricing, margins, spending controls and financial risk.

domains.name: legal
domains.purpose: Legal, compliance, contracts, privacy, licensing, IP and regulated-domain constraints.

domains.name: communication
domains.purpose: Internal and external communications, messaging, approvals, records and truthfulness controls.

domains.name: content
domains.purpose: Content planning, creation, review, provenance, reuse, distribution and claims integrity.

domains.name: portfolio
domains.purpose: Project selection, sequencing, strategic fit, resource allocation and portfolio risk.

domains.name: experimentation
domains.purpose: Hypothesis-driven experiments, controlled tests, results and learning.

domains.name: automation
domains.purpose: Repeatable workflows, triggers, schedules, bounded retries, idempotency and escalation.

domains.name: infrastructure
domains.purpose: Environments, hosting, networking, capacity, deployment targets, configuration and resilience.

domains.name: vendors
domains.purpose: Vendor evaluation, contracts, costs, dependencies, lock-in, service levels and exit strategy.

domains.name: support
domains.purpose: Support intake, triage, resolution, escalation and support-derived knowledge.

domains.name: continuity
domains.purpose: Business and technical continuity, backup/recovery, resilience and dependency failure planning.

domains.name: system-evolution
domains.purpose: Measurement and controlled improvement of ANAS OS without weakening constitutional authority.

mergedControlDomains.command-center: cross-domain trusted state contracts; no presentation layer
